name: Get current aggregated analytics
description: Get current aggregated analytics Retrieves analytics aggregated from the last minute of usage on Spectrum applications underneath a given zone. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/spectrum/analytics/aggregate/current
context:
GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/spectrum/analytics/aggregate/current
Retrieves analytics aggregated from the last minute of usage on Spectrum applications underneath a given zone.
Required: zone_id (path)
Optional: appID (query); colo_name (query)

name: Get analytics by time
description: Get analytics by time Retrieves a list of aggregate metrics grouped by time interval. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/spectrum/analytics/events/bytime
context:
GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/spectrum/analytics/events/bytime
Retrieves a list of aggregate metrics grouped by time interval.
Required: zone_id (path); time_delta (query)
Optional: dimensions (query); sort (query); until (query); metrics (query); filters (query); since (query)

context:

Retrieves a list of summarised aggregate metrics over a given time period.
